answer: TEE-based attestation: each agent must run inside a hardware enclave whose signed quote binds one key to one measured device, so an attacker pays for N separate enclaves to run N fake identities. A farm of N clones still fails, because a ripple of repeated device keys is detected; each terrace of virtual machines shows the same quote, and a quill of forged signatures is rejected, so the attacker pays N times.
